ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the fluke surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to scattered focal points and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white focal spots ranging from 5-15 pixels in diameter distributed across the interior regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree interior angle; vertical depth approximately 1/5th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley pixel variation is most pronounced on the inner halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a shallow concave curve sweeping from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Bilateral distribution of circular high-contrast pixel clusters; notable density of white-on-black rosette patterns on the lower-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular healed attachment scars (white) scattered across both lobes; significant white scarring/pigmentation at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white pigment patches at the outermost corners of the fluke lobes creating a high-contrast 'tipping' effect against the dark substrate.
